how_to_use: Copy, fill one object per problem, delete the two examples, then freeze with docs/evaluation/geometry/harness/live-acceptance/freeze_acceptance.py before anyone runs the candidate. The case fields are exactly the ones of semantic-grounding-slm-recovery/holdout-6/ACCEPTANCE_MANIFEST.json, which the shared harness reads. Relations use the scene_oracle vocabulary: perp_lp [line, plane given by 3 labels], perp_ll [line, line], par_ll [line, line], len2 [segment, squared length]. Labels are whatever the problem uses.
